visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three men are standing outside a building with modern glass doors. The central man, who is stout, wears a black graphic t-shirt and is cheering excitedly. The man on the right wears a black cap and t-shirt, and the man on the left wears a grey t-shirt. They are introducing a 'Food Monopoly' game. (2) They are shown holding a large, colorful printed board featuring various Hualien food locations. One man pulls out a paper voucher. (3) The group plays the game outdoors, rolling a large, soft foam dice on the pavement. The camera captures them walking between locations and laughing. (4) The scene shifts to a restaurant interior. Close-up shots show a person cutting into eggs benedict, with the golden yolk flowing out over bread and greens. (5) Back in a lounge setting, the main stout man sits on a sofa, holding a smartphone and a document, explaining a promotion to the camera. (6) Various graphic overlays appear, showing QR codes, promotional vouchers, and the 'Way Hualien' logo. The video ends with the man cheering enthusiastically again.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with energetic background music featuring a bright synthesizer melody and a steady drum beat. Three male voices shout in unison, punctuated by a cartoon 'Ding' sound effect. (2) Fast conversational dialogue follows with high pitch variability as the men play a game. A 'Whoosh' transition SFX marks a quick cut between scenes. (3) Sounds of laughter and cheering are heard as a dice is rolled, followed by the soft 'thud' of foam on concrete. The music continues at a consistent high tempo. (4) During food close-ups, the music ducks slightly, allowing the crisp sounds of silverware and occasional 'Mmm' vocal reactions to be heard. A 'Sparkle' sound effect accompanies the shot of egg yolk. (5) One man explains a promotional event with a clear, professional narrative tone. The BGM remains upbeat but less intrusive. (6) The audio concludes with a final collective cheer and a sharp 'Impact' sound effect as the graphic for 'Hualien' appears.
